briefing.headline: Tech rally fuels AMD up 5.1% and TSLA gains 2.6% as Tesla rolls out FSD v15
briefing.summary: All ten core mega‑cap tech tokens posted gains, with AMD leading at +5.1% and the broader market advancing 10‑0 on the overnight session. The move was led by the Nasdaq‑linked QQQ (+2.8%) and reinforced by modest rises in SPY and MSFT. Meanwhile, a slate of speculative tokens plunged, highlighted by CAPR down ~80% and SNDQ soaring +42.6% on its own volatility. Breadth was strongly positive on the core side but offset by heavy declines in many niche tokens.
